corpus.content: Nova uses a retrieval augmented generation pipeline that parses documents, creates overlapping chunks, retrieves evidence, builds a grounded prompt, and streams the answer.
User passwords are protected with salted PBKDF2 HMAC SHA256 using 310000 iterations. Authentication tokens are signed with HMAC SHA256.
Server Sent Events deliver language model tokens incrementally from FastAPI to the React client and allow generation cancellation.
Hybrid retrieval combines BM25 lexical ranking with FAISS semantic vectors. Reciprocal rank fusion merges the two ranked lists.
Backblaze B2 provides optional durable object storage for uploaded documents, vector indexes, users, and conversation history.
The responsive interface supports light, dark, and system themes, keyboard shortcuts, reduced motion, voice input, and animated transitions.
The readiness endpoint contacts the configured AI provider and verifies that the selected Groq or Ollama model is available before startup completes.
The FastAPI backend can deploy to Render while the Vite React frontend deploys to Vercel. Docker Compose supports local development.
